agreement.contract: Lighthouse CLR namespaces of Work Items types

facts.F1: Story #6360 S03b Package Work Items, nwdes feature B of three (the move). Move the Work Items files out of Services into Modules/WorkItems as the membership test of feature A lists them (Moves: 43 types incl. RefreshLogService and IRefreshLogService and the six helper types; Stays: the three tracker selectors and the orphan clean-up pair): sync mode, fetch fingerprint, the rule evaluator and the dependency policies into Domain (types the Domain rule rejects go to Application, recorded); WorkItemService (whole), TeamDataService, BlockedItemService, the rule ports and field providers, the dependency services and ports, the parent-placement report and the refresh log into Application; the six Work Items event handlers into Application/Policies. Dependency types go into the Dependencies sub-folders the rules name. Pure moves in their own commits, namespace edits apart. Rule lists that name moved types by full name name them in their new place; the CI test-selection classifier follows FetchFingerprint. Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, responses, refresh results, metrics answers, forecasts, handler order and the schema stay the same. Design: docs/feature/story-6360-s03b-package-work-items/feature-delta.md (slices B1-B3, D-1, D-8, Component decomposition, Ratchet design, DEVOPS).

facts.F15: Layer placement. Domain: SyncModeResolver, FetchFingerprint; Domain/Dependencies: DependencyHonourPolicy with IDependencyHonourPolicy, DependencyHonourInput and FeatureDependencyFacts (declared in the interface file), DependencyCycleDetector with DependencyLoops and DependencyLoop, DependencyFacts; RuleEvaluator<T> with IRuleEvaluator<T> in Domain, because a Domain type cannot reach an Application port and the port reaches only the kernel (deviation from D-1, which listed the port under Application). Final Domain membership is what the IL-reading Domain rule admits: a candidate that reaches anything beyond Models and the BCL goes to Application, recorded in the oracle list. Application: WorkItemService, IWorkItemService, BlockedItemService, IBlockedItemService, TeamDataService, ITeamDataService, IRuleFieldProvider, WorkItemFieldProvider, FeatureFieldProvider, ParentPlacementReport with RecordPlacement, RefreshLogService, IRefreshLogService; Application/Dependencies: DependencyDecision, DependencyReconciler, DependencyRefreshReporter, FeatureDependencyRendering with DependenciesAsRead, WhatTheForecastWaitsFor and IDependencyDecision, IDependencyReconciler, IDependencyRefreshReporter, IWhatTheForecastWaitsFor. Application/Policies: WorkItemBlockedTransitionCaptureHandler, WorkItemBlockedTransitionCloseHandler, FeatureBlockedTransitionCaptureHandler, FeatureBlockedTransitionCloseHandler, TeamDeletedRefreshLogCleanupHandler, ConnectionFetchShapeChangedUpdateTriggerHandler. Dependency types never sit flat in a layer: the sub-folders are the ones DependencySingleDecisionArchUnitTest's folder keys name.

facts.F16: Checker mapping: no state machine, temporal or fairness claim exists (behaviour-free relocation), so Quint, TLA+/TLC and Agda are not applicable and liveness is not applicable (no progress or scheduling change). Dependency-direction and placement claims are checked by IL-reading ArchUnit rules (ModuleRules.TypesLiveInTheirLayer and DomainReachesOnlyTheKernelAndTheBaseLibrary) in the three slice oracles; behaviour preservation by RefreshesStayTheSameTest and bash Scripts/examine/bin/refresh-answers-compare (base 8a785450c vs HEAD), plus metrics-answers-compare, forecast-answers-compare, ef-model-unchanged and architecture-rules. No property-based law: the finite relocation has no broad input domain.
facts.F17: Paradigm object_oriented, smell catalogue nw-code-design-oo: every moved type keeps its owner and responsibility; no domain decision moves into a service, no class is created, split or merged. Carriers unchanged: decisions in DependencyHonourPolicy, DependencyCycleDetector, RuleEvaluator, SyncModeResolver; effects in WorkItemService, TeamDataService, RefreshLogService and the handlers; no per-process state is added.

Unit tests of moved types stay in place and gain using lines only; they move in feature C. Feature A's oracle files may take a using-line edit forced by the move, recorded as a target, never a semantic change. TheNamespaceThisEpicOwns already covers Modules.WorkItems; if WorkItemService's move makes it reach the forecast, the crafter returns that to the architect and never loosens the rule.
facts.F19: Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, serialized responses, refresh results, metrics answers, forecasts, DI lifetimes, handler order and the schema stay the same. No bound on stored or validated inputs changes. Existing API, E2E and response tests stay green and unmodified apart from using lines.
